symbols.name: AutoFormField
signatures: <TFieldValues extends FieldValues = Record<string, any>, TName extends FieldPath<TFieldValues> = FieldPath<TFieldValues>>({ control, name, relation, showPlaceholderOnAll, isCreate, ...props }: { control: Control<TFieldValues>; name: TName; relation?: RelatedFieldConfig | undefined; showPlaceholderOnAll?: boolean | undefined; isCreate?: boolean | undefined; } & FieldFactoryProps & RefAttributes<HTMLDivElement>): Element
symbols.summary:
AutoFormField (自動連携フォームフィールド)

React Hook Form の `Controller` と `FieldFactory` を統合した高機能フィールドコンポーネントです。
以下の2つのモードで動作します。

1. **マニュアルモード**: `label`, `type`, `description` などの props を直接指定して使用します。
   標準的なフォーム作成に適しています。

2. **スキーマモード**: `jsonSchema` prop を渡すことで、スキーマ定義に基づいてウィジェット（入力UI）を自動決定します。
   国選択、都道府県、リレーション検索などの複雑な UI もスキーマの `x-ui` 定義から自動生成されます。

tags.name: example
tags.text:
```tsx
// 1. マニュアルモード
<AutoFormField
  control={form.control}
  name="email"
  label="メールアドレス"
  type="email"
  description="公開されません"
/>

// 2. スキーマモード
<AutoFormField
  control={form.control}
  name="address.country"
  jsonSchema={schema.properties.country} // { type: "string", "x-ui": { widget: "country" } }
/>
```

入力には `control` / `name` に加えて、`FieldFactory` の props を受け取ります。
`relation` はリレーション検索設定、`showPlaceholderOnAll` はプレースホルダー表示挙動を制御します。
`isCreate` は新規作成フォームであることを示し、`id` フィールドの自動的なロック（読み取り専用化）を防ぎます。

symbols.name: BigNumberDataAccessAdapter
symbols.summary: Wraps a host adapter to encode configured decimal paths as fixed-point strings and decode returned rows as decimal instances or strings. Dot paths and array wildcards are supported; the first matching configured path wins. Input JavaScript numbers may already have lost precision.

tags.name: remarks
tags.text: Null/undefined pass through; unconfigured values are preserved. Traversed objects/arrays are rebuilt, but untouched values can retain references. Backend capabilities and authorization remain with base. Optional methods are exposed but reject when the base capability is absent; replacements retain the base adapter's semantics. Conversion after a successful write can still reject without rollback.

tags.text: days - Number of 86,400,000-millisecond periods to add; negative and fractional values are accepted.

tags.name: returns
tags.text: A new Date from elapsed-millisecond arithmetic; invalid/non-finite inputs produce an invalid Date.

tags.text: This does not preserve wall-clock time across daylight-saving transitions and is not a civil-calendar day operation.

tags.text:

```ts
import { addDays } from '@alneas/appkit-core/data/date-utils';

```

symbols.name: generateZodSchema
signatures: (schema: JSONSchema): ZodObject<Readonly<{ [k: string]: $ZodType<unknown, unknown, $ZodTypeInternals<unknown, unknown>>; }>, $strip>
symbols.summary:
Generates a Zod validation schema from a JSONSchema.

Produces appropriate Zod validators according to property type/format,
applying implemented JSON Schema constraints and supported x-zod extensions.

tags.name: remarks
tags.text:
Partial conversion, not a JSON Schema evaluator. additionalProperties, type
unions and positive multipleOf are supported. Exclusive bounds, composition,
references and advanced array constraints are not generally preserved. format: date only
checks string type. Use createAjvValidator at the authoritative JSON boundary.
Only implemented x-zod options take effect; declarations do not imply support.
Root/nested required entries are checked even without properties declarations;
enum applies at the root as well as to nested values.
Declared/required __proto__ properties are rejected at conversion time.

tags.name: param
tags.text: schema - JSONSchema schema

tags.name: returns
tags.text: Zod object schema

tags.name: example

symbols.name: generateZodSchemaCode
signatures: (schema: JSONSchema): string
symbols.summary: Serializes a JSON Schema into a module that calls generateZodSchema at runtime.

tags.name: param
tags.text:
schema - JSON-serializable schema; title, then x-db.tableName, then
"unnamed" supplies the export-name prefix. Non-identifier characters become
underscores and a leading digit receives an underscore prefix.

tags.name: returns
tags.text:
Module source importing generateZodSchema from "./compiler.js" and exporting
the named schema by passing JSON.parse of the serialized input to that helper.

tags.name: throws
tags.text: Throws if JSON serialization fails, for example for cyclic input or BigInt.

tags.name: remarks
tags.text:
The output is not a standalone z.object expression and this function does not
validate or compile the schema. Evaluating the emitted module runs the helper
and can raise its schema-conversion errors. Provide a sibling compiler module
exporting generateZodSchema and a resolver that supports the emitted extensionless
import; native Node.js ESM does not resolve that import without adjustment.
The runtime helper uses Zod, which is a Core dependency.

symbols.name: GenerativeUIRenderer
signatures: ({ input, registry, renderFallback, }: GenerativeUIRendererProps): any
symbols.summary: Renders validated JSON blocks using an explicit application registry.

tags.name: remarks
tags.text:
Envelope validation snapshots input by reference. Pass immutable documents; replace
input when a response changes. Component validators run during rendering and must
be pure. Unknown types and invalid data get per-block fallbacks; malformed envelopes
get a document fallback. MinimalErrorBoundary isolates client render failures.
Block identity includes document ID, block ID/type and data.


Requires React; registered components own any other providers or CSS.
The default fallback is an English status paragraph. Client error boundaries handle
descendant render failures; React server rendering errors are not isolated by them.
Fallback callback errors propagate. Changing registry identity remounts blocks.

signatures: (adapter: AIChatAdapter, request: AIChatRequest, options?: AIChatStreamOptions | undefined): ReadableStream<any>

Shared send lifecycle for HTTP, custom and SDK consumers. Snapshots the request

tags.name: param
tags.text: options - Optional serialized-event character budget; defaults to {} and maxResponseChars 1000000 (maximum 10000000).

tags.name: returns
tags.text: A lazy ReadableStream; consume or cancel it to release the adapter iterator.

tags.name: throws
tags.text: Throws/rejects invalid configuration/history, aborts, invalid events, response limits or EOF without finish; events after finish also fail.

symbols.name: createActionToolBridge
signatures: (registry: ActionRegistry, options: ActionToolBridgeOptions): ActionToolBridge
symbols.summary: Creates an explicitly scoped, provider-neutral bridge to a screen registry.

tags.name: remarks
tags.text:
Tool schemas are application-owned, synchronous JSON Schema draft-07 or 2020-12.
Schemas are compiled on construction using the existing Ajv adapter with coercion,
defaults and property removal disabled. The registered action validator still runs.
No schema, handler, permission or output type is inferred from a TypeScript type.
Only mapOutput results are returned; registry metadata, errors and causes stay local.
The bridge reads the current registration at call time and rejects results if that
action was replaced during execution. Context lifetime checks are owned by the registry.
Duplicate call IDs (including failed calls) are rejected for this bridge's lifetime.
This is local retry protection, not durable idempotency or server authorization.
JSON schemas, arguments and projected outputs must be plain finite JSON data, at most
64 levels deep, 10000 nodes and 1000000 serialized characters per value.
Creating a bridge does not expose data externally or contact an AI service.

tags.name: param
tags.text: registry - Application registry whose current registrations are checked at each call.

tags.name: param
tags.text: options - Explicit tool bindings and optional positive safe-integer maxCalls (default 1000).

tags.name: returns
tags.text: An in-memory bridge with list/execute/close; close suppresses future/in-flight results without undoing effects.

tags.name: throws
tags.text: Throws invalid/duplicate names, invalid call limits/bindings or schema/snapshot compilation errors.

tags.name: example

signatures: (options?: AjvValidatorOptions | undefined): ((schema: object, data: unknown, overrides?: any) => { valid: boolean; errors: {}; rawErrors?: {} | undefined; }) & { ajv: any; }
symbols.summary: Creates an Ajv-based validator.

tags.name: remarks
tags.text:
Automatically selects draft-07/2020-12 based on $schema; compiled functions are not shared across instances.
Do not modify schemas after compilation; provide a new schema object instead.
The returned ajv instance corresponds to the default draft. Specify draft explicitly when using addSchema/addKeyword.
The default path disables type coercion and does not insert defaults or remove
keys. Explicit ajvOptions can enable input mutation. Unknown x-* keywords are
not business validation rules merely because strict mode is disabled.
Compilation/configuration failures throw; invalid data returns valid: false.
Runtime compilation requires a host that permits AJV's generated functions.

symbols.name: createExecutionSession
signatures: (options?: { readonly historyLimit?: number | undefined; } | undefined): ExecutionSession
symbols.summary:
Creates a framework-independent execution session (default history limit 50, max 1000).
One operation runs at a time. cancel changes status to cancelling and aborts its signal;
it does not race the promise or unlock a handler that ignores cancellation. A handler
resolving after cancellation is recorded as succeeded with cancelRequested=true.
Only an AbortError after a cancellation request is recorded as cancelled. Other errors
remain failures. Late progress updates are ignored. Observers cannot break execution.

History contains bounded labels/progress only, not inputs, results or exception details.
It is transient UI state, not an audit log or durable deduplication. Applications must
handle server authorization, idempotency and uncertain commit outcomes themselves.

tags.name: param
tags.text: options - Optional historyLimit configuration; defaults to {} and historyLimit 50.

tags.name: returns
tags.text: A single-flight in-memory session; the host must close it when no longer needed.

tags.name: throws
tags.text: Throws when historyLimit is not an integer from 1 to 1000.

tags.name: example

symbols.name: createGenerativeUIContract
signatures: (components: {}): GenerativeUIContract
symbols.summary: Builds a provider-neutral draft-07 response schema from explicit component definitions.

tags.name: remarks
tags.text:
Up to 32 unique type names, each with an inline object-root dataSchema. References,
IDs, anchors, dialect declarations and async schemas are rejected (including nested
reserved keys); this prevents reference rebasing and mixed-dialect ambiguity when
schemas are composed. No network loading occurs. Schemas are snapshotted/frozen and
compiled immediately using the existing Ajv adapter with coercion/defaults/removal
disabled. Invalid schemas throw configuration errors.
Exported schema describes structural constraints; runtime validation additionally
enforces unique block IDs and JSON size/depth limits. Custom business validators and
authorization still belong to the app. Provider-specific schema subsets may require
an application adapter; this function never contacts an AI service.

tags.name: param
tags.text: components - At most 32 uniquely named component schemas, each inline synchronous draft-07 with an object root.

tags.name: returns
tags.text: Frozen composed schema, component snapshots and local runtime validation helpers.

tags.name: throws
tags.text: Throws duplicate/invalid names, too many components, forbidden reference/dialect keys, non-JSON snapshots or Ajv schema errors.

tags.name: example

their failures are isolated per block. Rendering exceptions are handled by the renderer.
documentSchema is available only if every component declares dataSchema; missing
schemas are not guessed. It covers structural validation, not custom business rules.

signatures: <TRecord extends Record<string, any> = Record<string, any>>(options: UseProposalBatchReviewOptions<TRecord>): UseProposalBatchReviewReturn<TRecord>
symbols.summary: Reviews a batch with explicit field decisions and sequential host application.

tags.name: typeParam
tags.text: TRecord - Record shape; defaults to a string-keyed record.

tags.name: param
tags.text: options - Batch identity, unique immutable proposals/latest records, validation and optional host apply callback.

tags.name: returns
tags.text: Selection/decision controls, preflight state, bounded execution history and cooperative cancellation.

tags.name: remarks
tags.text:
Requires React; no context/styles. Changing batchId or serialized proposal
content starts a new session; unmount/session changes request cancellation. Each row
is rechecked against latest committed host inputs before apply. Stops at the first
failure/cancellation; successes remain excluded from retries. Cancellation cannot
undo host effects, so persist idempotently and enforce concurrency/authorization in
the backend. A row that changed the backend before rejecting has an uncertain outcome.
Keep the ref/layout-effect bridge for latest host inputs: the returned apply control
can be called by UI event handlers and other host code outside Effect logic.
useEffectEvent is restricted to Effect-originated callbacks and cannot replace this
externally callable execution path. The ref is not a React 18 compatibility shim.

tags.name: throws
tags.text: Host validateCandidate errors propagate from render.

tags.name: remarks
tags.text:
Requires React; no context or CSS. Changing proposal.id resets choices, error
and displayed submission state. A synchronous lock blocks duplicate apply calls.
Late results from an older displayed generation do not update the current review;
this does not cancel or roll back host effects. onApply errors become saveError and
handleApply returns false. No backend authorization or persistence is provided.

symbols.name: validateGenerativeUIDocument
signatures: (input: unknown): GenerativeUIDocumentResult
symbols.summary: Validates and snapshots a fully assembled UI document without a UI dependency.

tags.name: remarks
tags.text:
Requires version 1, a document ID, and at most 32 flat blocks with unique IDs.
Blocks have exactly id/type/data; the envelope has exactly version/id/blocks.
Data must be an object. Component names match `[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.-]{0,63}`.
All values must be plain finite JSON data: no accessors, functions, cycles,
sparse arrays, class instances or undefined. Limits: 64 nesting levels,
10000 nodes and 1000000 serialized characters for the entire document.
The successful result is cloned and recursively frozen; caller input is untouched.
This validates structure, not business data or authorization. Unknown component
names are allowed here and handled by the application's explicit UI registry.
Parse provider JSON and assemble streaming fragments before calling this function.

tags.name: param
tags.text: input - Fully assembled untrusted JSON document, after provider JSON parsing/fragment assembly.

tags.name: returns
tags.text: A detached frozen version-1 document or fixed INVALID_DOCUMENT failure; unknown component names are allowed at this envelope layer.

symbols.name: createActionToolBridge
signatures: (registry: ActionRegistry, options: ActionToolBridgeOptions): ActionToolBridge
symbols.summary: Creates an explicitly scoped, provider-neutral bridge to a screen registry.

tags.name: remarks
tags.text:
Tool schemas are application-owned, synchronous JSON Schema draft-07 or 2020-12.
Schemas are compiled on construction using the existing Ajv adapter with coercion,
defaults and property removal disabled. The registered action validator still runs.
No schema, handler, permission or output type is inferred from a TypeScript type.
Only mapOutput results are returned; registry metadata, errors and causes stay local.
The bridge reads the current registration at call time and rejects results if that
action was replaced during execution. Context lifetime checks are owned by the registry.
Duplicate call IDs (including failed calls) are rejected for this bridge's lifetime.
This is local retry protection, not durable idempotency or server authorization.
JSON schemas, arguments and projected outputs must be plain finite JSON data, at most
64 levels deep, 10000 nodes and 1000000 serialized characters per value.
Creating a bridge does not expose data externally or contact an AI service.

tags.name: param
tags.text: registry - Application registry whose current registrations are checked at each call.

tags.name: param
tags.text: options - Explicit tool bindings and optional positive safe-integer maxCalls (default 1000).

tags.name: returns
tags.text: An in-memory bridge with list/execute/close; close suppresses future/in-flight results without undoing effects.

tags.name: throws
tags.text: Throws invalid/duplicate names, invalid call limits/bindings or schema/snapshot compilation errors.

tags.name: example

signatures: (options?: { readonly historyLimit?: number | undefined; } | undefined): ExecutionSession
symbols.summary:
Creates a framework-independent execution session (default history limit 50, max 1000).
One operation runs at a time. cancel changes status to cancelling and aborts its signal;
it does not race the promise or unlock a handler that ignores cancellation. A handler
resolving after cancellation is recorded as succeeded with cancelRequested=true.

remain failures. Late progress updates are ignored. Observers cannot break execution.

History contains bounded labels/progress only, not inputs, results or exception details.
It is transient UI state, not an audit log or durable deduplication. Applications must
handle server authorization, idempotency and uncertain commit outcomes themselves.

symbols.name: validateGenerativeUIDocument
signatures: (input: unknown): GenerativeUIDocumentResult
symbols.summary: Validates and snapshots a fully assembled UI document without a UI dependency.

tags.name: remarks
tags.text:
Requires version 1, a document ID, and at most 32 flat blocks with unique IDs.
Blocks have exactly id/type/data; the envelope has exactly version/id/blocks.
Data must be an object. Component names match `[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.-]{0,63}`.
All values must be plain finite JSON data: no accessors, functions, cycles,
sparse arrays, class instances or undefined. Limits: 64 nesting levels,
10000 nodes and 1000000 serialized characters for the entire document.
The successful result is cloned and recursively frozen; caller input is untouched.
This validates structure, not business data or authorization. Unknown component
names are allowed here and handled by the application's explicit UI registry.
Parse provider JSON and assemble streaming fragments before calling this function.

tags.name: param
tags.text: input - Fully assembled untrusted JSON document, after provider JSON parsing/fragment assembly.

tags.name: returns
tags.text: A detached frozen version-1 document or fixed INVALID_DOCUMENT failure; unknown component names are allowed at this envelope layer.

tags.name: example

before returning, starts lazily on demand, requires finish followed by EOF,
rejects events after finish, and forwards abort to the adapter even during a read.
Cancellation settles promptly; an adapter must honor its signal to release I/O.
Iterator cleanup is requested, but never awaited behind an uncooperative next().
No storage, retry, resumption, tool execution or browser/SDK dependency.

tags.name: param
tags.text: options - Optional serialized-event character budget; defaults to {} and maxResponseChars 1000000 (maximum 10000000).

tags.name: returns
tags.text: A lazy ReadableStream; consume or cancel it to release the adapter iterator.

tags.name: throws
tags.text: Throws/rejects invalid configuration/history, aborts, invalid events, response limits or EOF without finish; events after finish also fail.

symbols.name: createActionToolBridge
signatures: (registry: ActionRegistry, options: ActionToolBridgeOptions): ActionToolBridge
symbols.summary: Creates an explicitly scoped, provider-neutral bridge to a screen registry.

tags.name: remarks
tags.text:
Tool schemas are application-owned, synchronous JSON Schema draft-07 or 2020-12.
Schemas are compiled on construction using the existing Ajv adapter with coercion,
defaults and property removal disabled. The registered action validator still runs.
No schema, handler, permission or output type is inferred from a TypeScript type.
Only mapOutput results are returned; registry metadata, errors and causes stay local.
The bridge reads the current registration at call time and rejects results if that
action was replaced during execution. Context lifetime checks are owned by the registry.
Duplicate call IDs (including failed calls) are rejected for this bridge's lifetime.
This is local retry protection, not durable idempotency or server authorization.
JSON schemas, arguments and projected outputs must be plain finite JSON data, at most
64 levels deep, 10000 nodes and 1000000 serialized characters per value.
Creating a bridge does not expose data externally or contact an AI service.

tags.name: param
tags.text: registry - Application registry whose current registrations are checked at each call.

tags.name: param
tags.text: options - Explicit tool bindings and optional positive safe-integer maxCalls (default 1000).

tags.name: returns
tags.text: An in-memory bridge with list/execute/close; close suppresses future/in-flight results without undoing effects.

tags.name: throws
tags.text: Throws invalid/duplicate names, invalid call limits/bindings or schema/snapshot compilation errors.

symbols.name: createAjvValidator
signatures: (options?: AjvValidatorOptions | undefined): ((schema: object, data: unknown, overrides?: any) => { valid: boolean; errors: {}; rawErrors?: {} | undefined; }) & { ajv: any; }
symbols.summary: Creates an Ajv-based validator.

tags.name: param
tags.text: options - Validation options.

tags.name: param
tags.text: options.locale - Error message language ('ja' | 'en'). Uses Ajv default messages if omitted.

tags.name: returns
tags.text: Validation execution function.

tags.name: remarks
tags.text:
Automatically selects draft-07/2020-12 based on $schema; compiled functions are not shared across instances.
Do not modify schemas after compilation; provide a new schema object instead.
The returned ajv instance corresponds to the default draft. Specify draft explicitly when using addSchema/addKeyword.
The default path disables type coercion and does not insert defaults or remove
keys. Explicit ajvOptions can enable input mutation. Unknown x-* keywords are
not business validation rules merely because strict mode is disabled.
Compilation/configuration failures throw; invalid data returns valid: false.
Runtime compilation requires a host that permits AJV's generated functions.

tags.name: throws
tags.text: Throws Ajv configuration/format-registration failures during construction; later schema compilation failures propagate from the returned validator.

symbols.name: createExecutionSession
signatures: (options?: { readonly historyLimit?: number | undefined; } | undefined): ExecutionSession
symbols.summary:
Creates a framework-independent execution session (default history limit 50, max 1000).
One operation runs at a time. cancel changes status to cancelling and aborts its signal;
it does not race the promise or unlock a handler that ignores cancellation. A handler
resolving after cancellation is recorded as succeeded with cancelRequested=true.
Only an AbortError after a cancellation request is recorded as cancelled. Other errors
remain failures. Late progress updates are ignored. Observers cannot break execution.

History contains bounded labels/progress only, not inputs, results or exception details.
It is transient UI state, not an audit log or durable deduplication. Applications must
handle server authorization, idempotency and uncertain commit outcomes themselves.

tags.name: param
tags.text: options - Optional historyLimit configuration; defaults to {} and historyLimit 50.

tags.name: returns
tags.text: A single-flight in-memory session; the host must close it when no longer needed.

tags.name: throws
tags.text: Throws when historyLimit is not an integer from 1 to 1000.

symbols.name: createGenerativeUIContract
signatures: (components: {}): GenerativeUIContract
symbols.summary: Builds a provider-neutral draft-07 response schema from explicit component definitions.

tags.name: remarks
tags.text:
Up to 32 unique type names, each with an inline object-root dataSchema. References,
IDs, anchors, dialect declarations and async schemas are rejected (including nested
reserved keys); this prevents reference rebasing and mixed-dialect ambiguity when
schemas are composed. No network loading occurs. Schemas are snapshotted/frozen and
compiled immediately using the existing Ajv adapter with coercion/defaults/removal
disabled. Invalid schemas throw configuration errors.
Exported schema describes structural constraints; runtime validation additionally
enforces unique block IDs and JSON size/depth limits. Custom business validators and
authorization still belong to the app. Provider-specific schema subsets may require
an application adapter; this function never contacts an AI service.

tags.name: param
tags.text: components - At most 32 uniquely named component schemas, each inline synchronous draft-07 with an object root.

tags.name: returns
tags.text: Frozen composed schema, component snapshots and local runtime validation helpers.

tags.name: throws
tags.text: Throws duplicate/invalid names, too many components, forbidden reference/dialect keys, non-JSON snapshots or Ajv schema errors.

signatures: <TRecord extends Record<string, any> = Record<string, any>>(entries: {}, validateCandidate?: ProposalBatchValidator<TRecord> | undefined): PreparedProposalBatch<TRecord>
symbols.summary:
Prepares every selected record before a multi-record apply starts.

input parser, cross-record business validator, database transaction or authorization
boundary. Payload candidates are shallow immutable snapshots, like buildApplyPayload.

symbols.name: validateGenerativeUIDocument
signatures: (input: unknown): GenerativeUIDocumentResult
symbols.summary: Validates and snapshots a fully assembled UI document without a UI dependency.

tags.name: remarks
tags.text:
Requires version 1, a document ID, and at most 32 flat blocks with unique IDs.
Blocks have exactly id/type/data; the envelope has exactly version/id/blocks.
Data must be an object. Component names match `[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.-]{0,63}`.
All values must be plain finite JSON data: no accessors, functions, cycles,
sparse arrays, class instances or undefined. Limits: 64 nesting levels,
10000 nodes and 1000000 serialized characters for the entire document.
The successful result is cloned and recursively frozen; caller input is untouched.
This validates structure, not business data or authorization. Unknown component
names are allowed here and handled by the application's explicit UI registry.
Parse provider JSON and assemble streaming fragments before calling this function.

tags.name: param
tags.text: input - Fully assembled untrusted JSON document, after provider JSON parsing/fragment assembly.

tags.name: returns
tags.text: A detached frozen version-1 document or fixed INVALID_DOCUMENT failure; unknown component names are allowed at this envelope layer.

signatures: (registry: ActionRegistry, options: ActionToolBridgeOptions): ActionToolBridge
symbols.summary: Creates an explicitly scoped, provider-neutral bridge to a screen registry.

tags.name: remarks
tags.text:
Tool schemas are application-owned, synchronous JSON Schema draft-07 or 2020-12.
Schemas are compiled on construction using the existing Ajv adapter with coercion,
defaults and property removal disabled. The registered action validator still runs.
No schema, handler, permission or output type is inferred from a TypeScript type.
Only mapOutput results are returned; registry metadata, errors and causes stay local.
The bridge reads the current registration at call time and rejects results if that
action was replaced during execution. Context lifetime checks are owned by the registry.
Duplicate call IDs (including failed calls) are rejected for this bridge's lifetime.
This is local retry protection, not durable idempotency or server authorization.
JSON schemas, arguments and projected outputs must be plain finite JSON data, at most
64 levels deep, 10000 nodes and 1000000 serialized characters per value.
Creating a bridge does not expose data externally or contact an AI service.

tags.name: param
tags.text: registry - Application registry whose current registrations are checked at each call.

tags.name: param
tags.text: options - Explicit tool bindings and optional positive safe-integer maxCalls (default 1000).

tags.name: returns
tags.text: An in-memory bridge with list/execute/close; close suppresses future/in-flight results without undoing effects.

tags.name: throws
tags.text: Throws invalid/duplicate names, invalid call limits/bindings or schema/snapshot compilation errors.

One operation runs at a time. cancel changes status to cancelling and aborts its signal;

remain failures. Late progress updates are ignored. Observers cannot break execution.

handle server authorization, idempotency and uncertain commit outcomes themselves.

IDs, anchors, dialect declarations and async schemas are rejected (including nested
reserved keys); this prevents reference rebasing and mixed-dialect ambiguity when
schemas are composed. No network loading occurs. Schemas are snapshotted/frozen and
compiled immediately using the existing Ajv adapter with coercion/defaults/removal
disabled. Invalid schemas throw configuration errors.
Exported schema describes structural constraints; runtime validation additionally
enforces unique block IDs and JSON size/depth limits. Custom business validators and
authorization still belong to the app. Provider-specific schema subsets may require
an application adapter; this function never contacts an AI service.

signatures: <TInput, TOutput>(definition: ActionToolDefinition<TInput, TOutput>): DefinedActionTool<TInput, TOutput>
symbols.summary: Defines a typed Action and Tool using one input schema and parser.

tags.name: remarks
tags.text:

symbols.name: validateGenerativeUIDocument
signatures: (input: unknown): GenerativeUIDocumentResult
symbols.summary: Validates and snapshots a fully assembled UI document without a UI dependency.

tags.name: remarks
tags.text:
Requires version 1, a document ID, and at most 32 flat blocks with unique IDs.
Blocks have exactly id/type/data; the envelope has exactly version/id/blocks.
Data must be an object. Component names match `[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.-]{0,63}`.
All values must be plain finite JSON data: no accessors, functions, cycles,
sparse arrays, class instances or undefined. Limits: 64 nesting levels,
10000 nodes and 1000000 serialized characters for the entire document.
The successful result is cloned and recursively frozen; caller input is untouched.
This validates structure, not business data or authorization. Unknown component
names are allowed here and handled by the application's explicit UI registry.
Parse provider JSON and assemble streaming fragments before calling this function.

tags.name: param
tags.text: input - Fully assembled untrusted JSON document, after provider JSON parsing/fragment assembly.

tags.name: returns
tags.text: A detached frozen version-1 document or fixed INVALID_DOCUMENT failure; unknown component names are allowed at this envelope layer.

symbols.name: createActionToolBridge
signatures: (registry: ActionRegistry, options: ActionToolBridgeOptions): ActionToolBridge
symbols.summary: Creates an explicitly scoped, provider-neutral bridge to a screen registry.

tags.name: remarks
tags.text:
Tool schemas are application-owned, synchronous JSON Schema draft-07 or 2020-12.
Schemas are compiled on construction using the existing Ajv adapter with coercion,
defaults and property removal disabled. The registered action validator still runs.
No schema, handler, permission or output type is inferred from a TypeScript type.
Only mapOutput results are returned; registry metadata, errors and causes stay local.
The bridge reads the current registration at call time and rejects results if that
action was replaced during execution. Context lifetime checks are owned by the registry.
Duplicate call IDs (including failed calls) are rejected for this bridge's lifetime.
This is local retry protection, not durable idempotency or server authorization.
JSON schemas, arguments and projected outputs must be plain finite JSON data, at most
64 levels deep, 10000 nodes and 1000000 serialized characters per value.
Creating a bridge does not expose data externally or contact an AI service.

tags.name: param
tags.text: registry - Application registry whose current registrations are checked at each call.

tags.name: param
tags.text: options - Explicit tool bindings and optional positive safe-integer maxCalls (default 1000).

tags.name: returns
tags.text: An in-memory bridge with list/execute/close; close suppresses future/in-flight results without undoing effects.

tags.name: throws
tags.text: Throws invalid/duplicate names, invalid call limits/bindings or schema/snapshot compilation errors.

signatures: (options?: { readonly historyLimit?: number | undefined; } | undefined): ExecutionSession
symbols.summary:
Creates a framework-independent execution session (default history limit 50, max 1000).
One operation runs at a time. cancel changes status to cancelling and aborts its signal;
it does not race the promise or unlock a handler that ignores cancellation. A handler
resolving after cancellation is recorded as succeeded with cancelRequested=true.
Only an AbortError after a cancellation request is recorded as cancelled. Other errors
remain failures. Late progress updates are ignored. Observers cannot break execution.

History contains bounded labels/progress only, not inputs, results or exception details.
It is transient UI state, not an audit log or durable deduplication. Applications must
handle server authorization, idempotency and uncertain commit outcomes themselves.

authorization still belong to the app. Provider-specific schema subsets may require

symbols.name: validateGenerativeUIDocument
signatures: (input: unknown): GenerativeUIDocumentResult
symbols.summary: Validates and snapshots a fully assembled UI document without a UI dependency.

tags.name: remarks
tags.text:
Requires version 1, a document ID, and at most 32 flat blocks with unique IDs.
Blocks have exactly id/type/data; the envelope has exactly version/id/blocks.
Data must be an object. Component names match `[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.-]{0,63}`.
All values must be plain finite JSON data: no accessors, functions, cycles,
sparse arrays, class instances or undefined. Limits: 64 nesting levels,
10000 nodes and 1000000 serialized characters for the entire document.
The successful result is cloned and recursively frozen; caller input is untouched.
This validates structure, not business data or authorization. Unknown component
names are allowed here and handled by the application's explicit UI registry.
Parse provider JSON and assemble streaming fragments before calling this function.

tags.name: param
tags.text: input - Fully assembled untrusted JSON document, after provider JSON parsing/fragment assembly.

tags.name: returns
tags.text: A detached frozen version-1 document or fixed INVALID_DOCUMENT failure; unknown component names are allowed at this envelope layer.

tags.name: example

symbols.name: AutoFormField
signatures: <TFieldValues extends FieldValues = Record<string, any>, TName extends FieldPath<TFieldValues> = FieldPath<TFieldValues>>({ control, name, relation, showPlaceholderOnAll, isCreate, ...props }: { control: Control<TFieldValues>; name: TName; relation?: RelatedFieldConfig | undefined; showPlaceholderOnAll?: boolean | undefined; isCreate?: boolean | undefined; } & FieldFactoryProps & RefAttributes<HTMLDivElement>): Element
symbols.summary:
AutoFormField (自動連携フォームフィールド)

React Hook Form の `Controller` と `FieldFactory` を統合した高機能フィールドコンポーネントです。
以下の2つのモードで動作します。

1. **マニュアルモード**: `label`, `type`, `description` などの props を直接指定して使用します。
   標準的なフォーム作成に適しています。

2. **スキーマモード**: `jsonSchema` prop を渡すことで、スキーマ定義に基づいてウィジェット（入力UI）を自動決定します。
   国選択、都道府県、リレーション検索などの複雑な UI もスキーマの `x-ui` 定義から自動生成されます。

tags.name: example
tags.text:
```tsx
// 1. マニュアルモード
<AutoFormField
  control={form.control}
  name="email"
  label="メールアドレス"
  type="email"
  description="公開されません"
/>

// 2. スキーマモード
<AutoFormField
  control={form.control}
  name="address.country"
  jsonSchema={schema.properties.country} // { type: "string", "x-ui": { widget: "country" } }
/>
```

入力には `control` / `name` に加えて、`FieldFactory` の props を受け取ります。
`relation` はリレーション検索設定、`showPlaceholderOnAll` はプレースホルダー表示挙動を制御します。
`isCreate` は新規作成フォームであることを示し、`id` フィールドの自動的なロック（読み取り専用化）を防ぎます。

signatures: <TFieldValues extends FieldValues>({ schema, validation, mode, values, submitLabel, onSubmit, onCancel, onDelete, onEdit, showEditButton, groupDisplay, relations, containerLayout, maxWidth, stickyActions, progressiveDisclosure, saveStatus, useGrid, children, className, }: EnhancedDetailPageProps<TFieldValues>): Element
symbols.summary: Renders schema-driven view/edit content with an optional container, advanced fields and action bar.

tags.name: typeParam
tags.text: TFieldValues - React Hook Form value shape passed to the submit callback.

tags.name: param
tags.text: props - Schema, host-owned values/actions and layout settings; see EnhancedDetailPageProps.

tags.name: returns
tags.text: The detail content inside a centered container or plain div.

tags.name: remarks
tags.text:
Import Appkit CSS. Generated edit content supplies its own React Hook Form provider
and form element; validation is opt-in via validation. Later values updates preserve dirty fields.
The host owns persistence, saveStatus, mode changes and errors from async onSubmit.
Custom children replace generated content and must supply their own form/provider wiring.
gridColumns is ignored; useGrid selects SchemaDetailPage layout and a 300px column minimum,
without guaranteeing an exact number of columns. No fixed two-column default is implemented.

tags.text: /appkit-react/styles in the rendering host. symbols.summary: Tracks downward touch motion and requests an asynchronous refresh after a threshold.

tags.name: remarks
tags.text: Import

tags.name: alneas
tags.text: /appkit-react/styles in the rendering host. DataList mounts both desktop/mobile representations; CSS switches visibility at md, so custom render callbacks may execute for both. It does not virtualize or add keyboard row activation. keyField must give stable unique stringifiable keys. ResponsiveGrid creates dynamic Tailwind classes: the host CSS must include the requested classes. Touch helpers do not add mouse/keyboard equivalents or persistence. A pull starts only when window.scrollY is zero. Visual distance is half the pointer displacement, capped at 100 CSS pixels; pullThreshold defaults to 80. Refresh is awaited, but there is no concurrency guard or finally cleanup: rejection leaves refreshing/pull state set. Handle errors inside onRefresh when recovery is needed. Native touch handlers supplied in props override the wrapper handlers.

symbols.name: addDays
signatures: (date: any, days: number): Date
symbols.summary: Adds multiples of a fixed 24-hour duration to an instant.

tags.name: param
tags.text: date - Date or runtime-parseable string providing the starting instant.

tags.name: param
tags.text: days - Number of 86,400,000-millisecond periods to add; negative and fractional values are accepted.

tags.name: returns
tags.text: A new Date from elapsed-millisecond arithmetic; invalid/non-finite inputs produce an invalid Date.

tags.name: remarks
tags.text: This does not preserve wall-clock time across daylight-saving transitions and is not a civil-calendar day operation.

tags.name: example
tags.text:
```ts
import { addDays } from '@alneas/appkit-core/data/date-utils';
console.log(addDays('2024-01-15T00:00:00Z', 7).toISOString()); // '2024-01-22T00:00:00.000Z'
```

symbols.name: generateZodSchema
signatures: (schema: JSONSchema): ZodObject<Readonly<{ [k: string]: $ZodType<unknown, unknown, $ZodTypeInternals<unknown, unknown>>; }>, $strip>
symbols.summary:
Generates a Zod validation schema from a JSONSchema.

Produces appropriate Zod validators according to property type/format,
applying implemented JSON Schema constraints and supported x-zod extensions.

tags.name: remarks
tags.text:
Partial conversion, not a JSON Schema evaluator. additionalProperties, type
unions and positive multipleOf are supported. Exclusive bounds, composition,
references and advanced array constraints are not generally preserved. format: date only
checks string type. Use createAjvValidator at the authoritative JSON boundary.
Only implemented x-zod options take effect; declarations do not imply support.
Root/nested required entries are checked even without properties declarations;
enum applies at the root as well as to nested values.
Declared/required __proto__ properties are rejected at conversion time.

tags.name: param
tags.text: schema - JSONSchema schema

tags.name: returns
tags.text: Zod object schema

tags.name: example

symbols.name: generateZodSchemaCode
signatures: (schema: JSONSchema): string
symbols.summary: Serializes a JSON Schema into a module that calls generateZodSchema at runtime.

tags.name: param
tags.text:
schema - JSON-serializable schema; title, then x-db.tableName, then
"unnamed" supplies the export-name prefix. Non-identifier characters become
underscores and a leading digit receives an underscore prefix.

tags.name: returns
tags.text:
Module source importing generateZodSchema from "./compiler.js" and exporting
the named schema by passing JSON.parse of the serialized input to that helper.

tags.name: throws
tags.text: Throws if JSON serialization fails, for example for cyclic input or BigInt.

tags.name: remarks
tags.text:
The output is not a standalone z.object expression and this function does not
validate or compile the schema. Evaluating the emitted module runs the helper
and can raise its schema-conversion errors. Provide a sibling compiler module
exporting generateZodSchema and a resolver that supports the emitted extensionless
import; native Node.js ESM does not resolve that import without adjustment.
The runtime helper uses Zod, which is a Core dependency.

tags.name: example

tags.name: remarks
tags.text: Requires React and

tags.name: tanstack
tags.text:
/react-query; no CSS is required. Each mounted
provider scopes its session query. Initial verification and principal changes cancel
and remove application queries in the shared QueryClient and remount children;
same-user refreshes preserve them. Use separate QueryClients for independent auth domains.
SSR and hydration begin with user null and isLoading true. Subscriptions start after
mount and are disposed on cleanup. With optimisticSession, an unexpired localStorage
snapshot can appear while isSessionVerified remains false; gate sensitive UI on backend
verification. Storage contains the adapter's User display fields, so exclude secrets.
Cross-reload reuse requires an explicit non-secret adapter.cacheScope. Cache separation
is not authorization; the backend must enforce access. Login/register/logout/OAuth
failures reject and are exposed as context errors. Other adapter actions forward
their failures to the caller; session reads use TanStack Query error handling.

symbols.name: AutoFormField
signatures: <TFieldValues extends FieldValues = Record<string, any>, TName extends FieldPath<TFieldValues> = FieldPath<TFieldValues>>({ control, name, relation, showPlaceholderOnAll, isCreate, ...props }: { control: Control<TFieldValues>; name: TName; relation?: RelatedFieldConfig | undefined; showPlaceholderOnAll?: boolean | undefined; isCreate?: boolean | undefined; } & FieldFactoryProps & RefAttributes<HTMLDivElement>): Element
symbols.summary:
AutoFormField (自動連携フォームフィールド)

React Hook Form の `Controller` と `FieldFactory` を統合した高機能フィールドコンポーネントです。
以下の2つのモードで動作します。

1. **マニュアルモード**: `label`, `type`, `description` などの props を直接指定して使用します。
   標準的なフォーム作成に適しています。

2. **スキーマモード**: `jsonSchema` prop を渡すことで、スキーマ定義に基づいてウィジェット（入力UI）を自動決定します。
   国選択、都道府県、リレーション検索などの複雑な UI もスキーマの `x-ui` 定義から自動生成されます。

tags.name: example
tags.text:
```tsx
// 1. マニュアルモード
<AutoFormField
  control={form.control}
  name="email"
  label="メールアドレス"
  type="email"
  description="公開されません"
/>

// 2. スキーマモード
<AutoFormField
  control={form.control}
  name="address.country"
  jsonSchema={schema.properties.country} // { type: "string", "x-ui": { widget: "country" } }
/>
```

入力には `control` / `name` に加えて、`FieldFactory` の props を受け取ります。
`relation` はリレーション検索設定、`showPlaceholderOnAll` はプレースホルダー表示挙動を制御します。
`isCreate` は新規作成フォームであることを示し、`id` フィールドの自動的なロック（読み取り専用化）を防ぎます。

tags.text:

filtering and identifier conversion. Optional methods must be capability-checked.

tags.name: alneas
tags.text: /appkit-react/styles in the rendering host. DataList mounts both desktop/mobile representations; CSS switches visibility at md, so custom render callbacks may execute for both. It does not virtualize or add keyboard row activation. keyField must give stable unique stringifiable keys. ResponsiveGrid creates dynamic Tailwind classes: the host CSS must include the requested classes. Touch helpers do not add mouse/keyboard equivalents or persistence. A pull starts only when window.scrollY is zero. Visual distance is half the pointer displacement, capped at 100 CSS pixels; pullThreshold defaults to 80. Refresh is awaited, but there is no concurrency guard or finally cleanup: rejection leaves refreshing/pull state set. Handle errors inside onRefresh when recovery is needed. Native touch handlers supplied in props override the wrapper handlers.

```ts
import { addDays } from '@alneas/appkit-core/data/date-utils';

```

signatures: <TData = unknown, TError = unknown, TVariables = void, TContext = unknown>(mutationFn: MutationFunction<TData, TVariables>, options?: (UseMutationOptions<TData, TError, TVariables, TContext> & { invalidateKeys?: {} | ((data: TData, variables: TVariables) => {}) | undefined; }) | undefined): UseMutationResult<TData, TError, TVariables, TContext>
symbols.summary: Runs a TanStack mutation and invalidates only the explicitly configured query keys on success.

tags.name: typeParam
tags.text: TData - Resolved mutation result; defaults to unknown and may include undefined.

tags.name: typeParam
tags.text: TError - Mutation error exposed by TanStack Query; defaults to unknown.

tags.name: typeParam
tags.text: TVariables - Mutation input supplied to mutate/mutateAsync; defaults to void.

tags.name: typeParam
tags.text: TContext - Value returned by onMutate for later callbacks; defaults to unknown.

tags.name: param
tags.text: mutationFn - Host mutation function receiving variables and resolving TData; the host owns authorization and persistence.

tags.name: param
tags.text:
options - TanStack mutation options plus invalidateKeys: a key array or synchronous factory
receiving the successful result and variables. Omitted invalidateKeys (or an empty array) invalidates nothing.

tags.name: returns
tags.text: The TanStack mutation result with status, data/error and mutate/mutateAsync controls.

tags.name: throws
tags.text: When rendered without a QueryClientProvider.

tags.name: remarks
tags.text:
Requires an outer QueryClientProvider. Query keys use TanStack prefix matching.
On success, invalidations run concurrently and are awaited before options.onSuccess is called;
that callback's returned promise is not awaited by this wrapper. A key factory or invalidation
failure prevents that callback and propagates into mutation error handling. Mutation failures
are exposed through the mutation result and reject mutateAsync. This wrapper adds no retry,
rollback or default invalidation keys; useCreate/useUpdate supply their own defaults.
The normal TanStack options spread also permits options.mutationFn to override the first argument.

tags.name: example

symbols.name: planGanttTasks
signatures: <T extends GanttPlanningTask>(tasks: {}, dependencies: {}, options?: GanttSchedulingOptions | undefined): GanttScheduleResult<T>
symbols.summary:
Plan whole working days with a shared calendar and optional resource capacities.
Dates must be local midnight (date-only strings are parsed locally). Finishes are
exclusive next-working-day boundaries. A positive span with no working days gets
one day; durationDays overrides inferred duration, including zero-day milestones.

Stable topological/input order decides resource precedence. Tasks are never split,
pulled before their input starts, or optimized for shortest makespan. All statuses
participate; actual/frozen work and individual resource calendars are not modeled.
Summary rows are preserved but excluded from planning. Invalid inputs, cycles,
over-capacity demand and exhausted search bounds throw without mutating inputs.
CPM is dependency-only BEFORE leveling; capacity delays are reported separately.

tags.name: param
tags.text: tasks - Task records with unique IDs and release dates; inputs are not mutated.

tags.name: param
tags.text: dependencies - Unique directed leaf-task links using FS/SS/FF/SF and integer lagDays.

tags.name: param
tags.text: options - Optional working calendar, resource leveling and search bounds; defaults to {} for the planner. Omitting it from scheduleGanttTasks preserves legacy calendar-day/time-of-day behavior.

tags.name: returns
tags.text: Scheduled tasks, dependency-only CPM, capacity delays and project finish; empty leaf input has empty diagnostics and null finish.

tags.name: throws
tags.text: Throws invalid graph/date/calendar/duration inputs or exhausted search bounds; the working-day planner also rejects infeasible resource demand.

tags.name: typeParam
tags.text: T - Consumer task shape extending the required scheduling fields; extra fields are preserved.

tags.name: example

and optional capacity leveling. Omit it to preserve legacy time-of-day behavior.

symbols.summary:
Set the locale.

Updates the locale using your configured strategies (cookie, localStorage, URL, etc.).
By default, this navigates the client to the localized URL or reloads the current
document to reflect the new locale. `reload: false` is a narrow browser-only escape
hatch for a fully client-rendered, non-URL-routed surface that owns its reactive
updates and document state. It does not re-render the UI or update the document.
Do not use it for normal locale pickers, URL-routed pages, or switching an SSR,
SSG, or hydrated document. It is incompatible with per-locale builds.

If any custom strategy's `setLocale` function is async, then this function
will become async as well.

symbols.name: AutoFormField
signatures: <TFieldValues extends FieldValues = Record<string, any>, TName extends FieldPath<TFieldValues> = FieldPath<TFieldValues>>({ control, name, relation, showPlaceholderOnAll, isCreate, ...props }: { control: Control<TFieldValues>; name: TName; relation?: RelatedFieldConfig | undefined; showPlaceholderOnAll?: boolean | undefined; isCreate?: boolean | undefined; } & FieldFactoryProps & RefAttributes<HTMLDivElement>): Element
symbols.summary:
AutoFormField (自動連携フォームフィールド)

React Hook Form の `Controller` と `FieldFactory` を統合した高機能フィールドコンポーネントです。
以下の2つのモードで動作します。

1. **マニュアルモード**: `label`, `type`, `description` などの props を直接指定して使用します。
   標準的なフォーム作成に適しています。

2. **スキーマモード**: `jsonSchema` prop を渡すことで、スキーマ定義に基づいてウィジェット（入力UI）を自動決定します。
   国選択、都道府県、リレーション検索などの複雑な UI もスキーマの `x-ui` 定義から自動生成されます。

tags.name: example
tags.text:
```tsx
// 1. マニュアルモード
<AutoFormField
  control={form.control}
  name="email"
  label="メールアドレス"
  type="email"
  description="公開されません"
/>

// 2. スキーマモード
<AutoFormField
  control={form.control}
  name="address.country"
  jsonSchema={schema.properties.country} // { type: "string", "x-ui": { widget: "country" } }
/>
```

入力には `control` / `name` に加えて、`FieldFactory` の props を受け取ります。
`relation` はリレーション検索設定、`showPlaceholderOnAll` はプレースホルダー表示挙動を制御します。
`isCreate` は新規作成フォームであることを示し、`id` フィールドの自動的なロック（読み取り専用化）を防ぎます。

/appkit-react/styles in the host for Appkit theme styling.
No query/auth provider is required. Stored values override defaults on the client;

to localStorage; custom colors are in-memory state. Coordinate multiple providers
because they write the same document root. Stored values are cast without validation.
